# === REGISTRO DE ERRORES ===
error_data = _items[0]["json"]

registro_error = {
    "error_event": "Fallo en el procesamiento del oficio",
    "workflow": error_data.get("workflow", {}).get("name", "N/D"),
    "error_message": error_data.get("execution", {}).get("error", {}).get("message", "Error desconocido"),
    "node": error_data.get("execution", {}).get("error", {}).get("node", {}).get("name", "N/D"),
    "timestamp": error_data.get("execution", {}).get("lastNodeExecuted", "N/D"),
    "status": "error_logged",
}

return [{"json": registro_error}]
